I've played through the Diablo franchise and Torchlight. What are some other crawlers for PC that are as good or better?
What are some other games that are similar to Diablo III for PC?

Path of Exile is a must. It was a really awesome skill tree (super huge and every class can get every upgrade, you just start in your own corner) and the active skills you use are determined by the gems you have socketed. It's also free but not F2P. The purchases are cosmetic stuff like fancy flame effects for your weapons and such.

It's also free but not F2P.

It is absolutely 100% free-2-play. However, there is an in-store cash shop, which will allow you to buy non pay-2-win features; such as cosmetic effects and alternate skill effects. The only thing that even so much as comes close to bordering the pay to win aspect is that you can buy more stash space. But you can 100% download the game and start playing and beat the entire game without ever spending a dime. Hell, you could even get cosmetics from accomplishing certain leagues/races and still not spend a dime.

The Synergies mod really takes T2 up an entire level. There was an unlimited dungeons mod I thought was fucking awesome too, and another mod for randomly generated dungeons.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MAmn4x2r-O8 - Lost Ark Debut Watch all 19 minutes, I assure you, it gets better. This seems to be the MMO I've been waiting for my entire life.

Try the Fate series. A little child-like but it will provide you with countless hours of randomly generated fun. There's not much story or purpose but if dungeon diving and killing beasts and loot is your thing that's this game exactly. And for a nice feature not in others of this kind you have a pet dog or cat from the start that adventures with you and can temporarily turn into various monsters if you feed it the right kind of fish. They're great games with the one great downfall that there is no interesting story to follow so it has the potential to get old fast.
Fate's author co-founded Runic Games, so there're a lot of similarities to Torchlight (the pets, fishes).
Oh wow I did not know that. The trouble with Torchlight is that it's all online isn't it? I definitely checked it out at some stage and wasn't happy with something like that.

No, Torchlight 1 is singleplayer only. Torchlight 2 can be played singleplayer or LAN multiplayer without ever connecting to the net. You only need to be online for multiplayer through Runic's servers.

Diablo 3 is the one that is always online -- can't even launch the game during Battle.net maintenance. And singleplayer suffers from network latency (probably certain functions are server-side to prevent cheating).

Torchlight 2 gets pretty cheap and has full mod support, so I'd recommend it if you like the genre. I expect it'll be played forever much like Diablo 2.

I'd suggest giving Titan Quest a try. It's ridiculously fun and has pretty good replay value.

• Titan Quest - lots of classes and skills, quite replayable
  • Van Helsing - good for a single playthrough
  • Torchlight 2 - official mod support, in many ways the spiritual successor to D2

PoE wasn't enjoyable for me, has the usual MMO pitfalls (grinding), although the skill tree is amazing to look at.

Outside of fantasy, Shadowrun Returns is futuristic scifi magitek and has a couple of major campaign expansions as well as tons of user created content.
